def create_acc.protected_filter_entry
  (ident : Identity) (entry : Entry) : Result create_acc.IResult := do
  match ident.origin with
  | IdentType.User _ =>
    let o ← entry_impl.get_uuid_init entry
    match o with
    | none =>
      let s ←
        lift (Array.to_slice
          (Array.make 5#usize [ 99#u8, 108#u8, 97#u8, 115#u8, 115#u8 ]))
      let o1 ← entry_impl.get_ava_as_iutf8 entry s
      match o1 with
      | none => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
      | some classes =>
        let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref classes
        let b ← protected.disjoint_protected_entry_classes s1
        if b
        then ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
        else ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
    | some entry_uuid =>
      if entry_uuid <= UUID_ANONYMOUS
      then ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
      else
        let s ←
          lift (Array.to_slice
            (Array.make 5#usize [ 99#u8, 108#u8, 97#u8, 115#u8, 115#u8 ]))
        let o1 ← entry_impl.get_ava_as_iutf8 entry s
        match o1 with
        | none => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
        | some classes =>
          let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref classes
          let b ← protected.disjoint_protected_entry_classes s1
          if b
          then ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
          else ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
  | IdentType.Synch _ => ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
  | IdentType.Internal ir =>
    match ir with
    | InternalRole.System => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
    | InternalRole.Migration =>
      let o ← entry_impl.get_uuid_init entry
      match o with
      | none =>
        let s ←
          lift (Array.to_slice
            (Array.make 5#usize [ 99#u8, 108#u8, 97#u8, 115#u8, 115#u8 ]))
        let o1 ← entry_impl.get_ava_as_iutf8 entry s
        match o1 with
        | none => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
        | some classes =>
          let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref classes
          let b ← protected.disjoint_protected_entry_classes s1
          if b
          then ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
          else ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
      | some entry_uuid =>
        if entry_uuid <= UUID_ANONYMOUS
        then ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
        else
          let s ←
            lift (Array.to_slice
              (Array.make 5#usize [ 99#u8, 108#u8, 97#u8, 115#u8, 115#u8 ]))
          let o1 ← entry_impl.get_ava_as_iutf8 entry s
          match o1 with
          | none => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
          | some classes =>
            let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref classes
            let b ← protected.disjoint_protected_entry_classes s1
            if b
            then ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
            else ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
    | InternalRole.AccountRequest => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
    | InternalRole.MessageQueue => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore

def create_acc.apply_create_access
  (ident : Identity) (related_acp : Slice profiles.AccessControlCreateResolved)
  (entry : Entry) :
  Result create_acc.CreateResult
  := do
  let i ← create_acc.protected_filter_entry ident entry
  let denied ←
    match i with
    | create_acc.IResult.Deny => ok true
    | create_acc.IResult.Grant => ok false
    | create_acc.IResult.Ignore => ok false
    | create_acc.IResult.Allow _ _ => ok false
  let i1 ← create_acc.message_queue ident entry
  let (denied1, grant, allow_pres, allow_pres_cls) ←
    match i1 with
    | create_acc.IResult.Deny =>
      ok (true, false, alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8),
        alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
    | create_acc.IResult.Grant =>
      ok (denied, true, alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8),
        alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
    | create_acc.IResult.Ignore =>
      ok (denied, false, alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8),
        alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
    | create_acc.IResult.Allow pres pres_cls =>
      do
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres
      let allow_pres1 ←
        bset.extend (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)) s
      let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres_cls
      let allow_pres_cls1 ←
        bset.extend (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)) s1
      ok (denied, false, allow_pres1, allow_pres_cls1)
  let i2 ← create_acc.migration_filter_entry ident entry
  let (denied2, grant1, allow_pres1, allow_pres_cls1) ←
    match i2 with
    | create_acc.IResult.Deny => ok (true, grant, allow_pres, allow_pres_cls)
    | create_acc.IResult.Grant =>
      ok (denied1, true, allow_pres, allow_pres_cls)
    | create_acc.IResult.Ignore =>
      ok (denied1, grant, allow_pres, allow_pres_cls)
    | create_acc.IResult.Allow pres pres_cls =>
      do
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres
      let allow_pres2 ← bset.extend allow_pres s
      let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres_cls
      let allow_pres_cls2 ← bset.extend allow_pres_cls s1
      ok (denied1, grant, allow_pres2, allow_pres_cls2)
  let i3 ← create_acc.create_filter_entry ident related_acp entry
  let (denied3, grant2, allow_pres2, allow_pres_cls2) ←
    match i3 with
    | create_acc.IResult.Deny =>
      ok (true, grant1, allow_pres1, allow_pres_cls1)
    | create_acc.IResult.Grant =>
      ok (denied2, true, allow_pres1, allow_pres_cls1)
    | create_acc.IResult.Ignore =>
      ok (denied2, grant1, allow_pres1, allow_pres_cls1)
    | create_acc.IResult.Allow pres pres_cls =>
      do
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres
      let allow_pres3 ← bset.extend allow_pres1 s
      let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref pres_cls
      let allow_pres_cls3 ← bset.extend allow_pres_cls1 s1
      ok (denied2, grant1, allow_pres3, allow_pres_cls3)
  if denied3
  then ok create_acc.CreateResult.Deny
  else
    if grant2
    then ok create_acc.CreateResult.Grant
    else
      let i4 := alloc.vec.Vec.len (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
      let allowed_pres ←
        if i4 != 0#usize
        then
          let s :=
            alloc.vec.Vec.deref (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
          let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref allow_pres2
          bset.intersection s s1
        else ok allow_pres2
      let i5 := alloc.vec.Vec.len (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
      let allowed_pres_cls ←
        if i5 != 0#usize
        then
          let s :=
            alloc.vec.Vec.deref (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
          let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref allow_pres_cls2
          bset.intersection s s1
        else ok allow_pres_cls2
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref allowed_pres_cls
      let allowed_pres_cls1 ← protected.remove_protected_mod_pres s
      ok (create_acc.CreateResult.Allow allowed_pres allowed_pres_cls1)

def create_acc.migration_filter_entry
  (ident : Identity) (entry : Entry) : Result create_acc.IResult := do
  match ident.origin with
  | IdentType.User _ => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
  | IdentType.Synch _ => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
  | IdentType.Internal ir =>
    match ir with
    | InternalRole.System => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
    | InternalRole.Migration =>
      let s ←
        lift (Array.to_slice
          (Array.make 5#usize [ 99#u8, 108#u8, 97#u8, 115#u8, 115#u8 ]))
      let o ← entry_impl.get_ava_as_iutf8 entry s
      match o with
      | none => ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
      | some classes =>
        let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref classes
        let classes1 ← migration.sub_migration_ignore s1
        let s2 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref classes1
        let b ← migration.subset_migration_entry s2
        if b
        then
          let s3 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref classes1
          let (allow_attrs, allow_cls) ← migration.migration_entry_attrs s3
          let i := alloc.vec.Vec.len allow_attrs
          if i = 0#usize
          then ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
          else ok (create_acc.IResult.Allow allow_attrs allow_cls)
        else ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
    | InternalRole.AccountRequest => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
    | InternalRole.MessageQueue => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore

def create_acc.create_filter_entry
  (ident : Identity) (related_acp : Slice profiles.AccessControlCreateResolved)
  (entry : Entry) :
  Result create_acc.IResult
  := do
  match ident.origin with
  | IdentType.User _ =>
    let «as» ← identity_impl.access_scope ident
    match «as» with
    | AccessScope.ReadOnly => ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
    | AccessScope.ReadWrite =>
      let create_attrs ← entry_impl.get_ava_names entry
      let s ←
        lift (Array.to_slice
          (Array.make 5#usize [ 99#u8, 108#u8, 97#u8, 115#u8, 115#u8 ]))
      let o ← entry_impl.get_ava_as_iutf8 entry s
      match o with
      | none => ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
      | some s1 =>
        let s2 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref create_attrs
        let s3 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref s1
        let allow ← create_acc.create_any_acp related_acp entry s2 s3
        if allow
        then ok create_acc.IResult.Grant
        else ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
    | AccessScope.Synchronise => ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
  | IdentType.Synch _ => ok create_acc.IResult.Deny
  | IdentType.Internal ir =>
    match ir with
    | InternalRole.System => ok create_acc.IResult.Grant
    | InternalRole.Migration => ok create_acc.IResult.Ignore
    | InternalRole.AccountRequest =>
      let s ←
        lift (Array.to_slice
          (Array.make 5#usize [ 99#u8, 108#u8, 97#u8, 115#u8, 115#u8 ]))
      let pres ← bset.insert (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)) s
      let s1 ←

            102#u8, 116#u8, 101#u8, 114#u8

            100#u8, 105#u8, 115#u8, 112#u8, 108#u8, 97#u8, 121#u8, 110#u8,
            97#u8, 109#u8, 101#u8
            ]))
      let pres2 ← bset.insert pres1 s2
      let s3 ←
        lift (Array.to_slice
          (Array.make 4#usize [ 109#u8, 97#u8, 105#u8, 108#u8 ]))
      let pres3 ← bset.insert pres2 s3
      let s4 ←
        lift (Array.to_slice
          (Array.make 4#usize [ 110#u8, 97#u8, 109#u8, 101#u8 ]))
      let pres4 ← bset.insert pres3 s4
      let s5 ←
        lift (Array.to_slice
          (Array.make 4#usize [ 117#u8, 117#u8, 105#u8, 100#u8 ]))
      let pres5 ← bset.insert pres4 s5
      let s6 ←
        lift (Array.to_slice
          (Array.make 6#usize [ 111#u8, 98#u8, 106#u8, 101#u8, 99#u8, 116#u8 ]))
      let pres_cls ←
        bset.insert (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)) s6
      let s7 ←
        lift (Array.to_slice
          (Array.make 22#usize [
            97#u8, 99#u8, 99#u8, 111#u8, 117#u8, 110#u8, 116#u8, 95#u8, 115#u8,
            105#u8, 103#u8, 110#u8, 117#u8, 112#u8, 95#u8, 114#u8, 101#u8,
